summary: Twelve days to FreightWorks Expo. Duplicates fix, retry queue and error-rate alert are live, and the Harbor QBR is done with follow-ups logged. Slot picker PR #241 awaits Sam's design review, blocking demo screen 3. Pricing numbers are due from Maya today. Pinecrest demo is Monday.

items.text: Duplicates fix (TW-103, PR #238) is approved and shipped, and the retry queue (TW-104) is live in production. Ridgeline renewal is Nov 20, health yellow.
Nina's error-rate alert (TW-105) is live. This answers Harbor's question about learning of outages first.
Harbor QBR done. Dana's team liked the export fix and time zone display, and Maya shared the renewal terms there (TW-136 done). Renewal is Oct 30.
Dana wants written notes from the QBR. TW-139 is owned by Jordan, due today, 1h, todo.
Dana asked for a 4-week dock trend in Harbor's weekly report. TW-140 is owned by Sam, 3h, no due date.
Harbor's ops lead asked to receive the same sync alerts as Tidewell. TW-142 is owned by Nina, 2h, no due date.
Slot picker build is up as PR #241 but cannot merge until Sam completes the design review (TW-141, 1h). Sam's demo screen 3 (TW-119) also waits on this build.
Leila says the booth tablet uses the real slot picker, so it must be stable by Oct 28. Empty and error states (TW-135, due Oct 29) are in progress.
Arjun created TW-143: load test the scoring API at 10x expected booth traffic, owner Nina, due Oct 30, 4h. TW-115 (due Oct 28) has load testing next.
Coastal's early-morning dock suggestions look off. Nina's ranking tuning TW-138 is now in progress, due Oct 28, 4h.
Arjun owes Coastal and Valley the API docs by Oct 26 (TW-127, in progress).
Pricing page (TW-125) and the printed one-pager wait for final pricing numbers, promised by Maya for today. Maya wants the same numbers on both.
Dry run showed the full booth demo takes 2:40. Sam wants it under two minutes. Jordan expects visitors to ask about pricing first.
Pinecrest live demo is Monday. It is needed for the third design partner (TW-126, due Oct 30).
Valley's data is flowing and its Smart Slots setup starts Monday. Coastal is live in staging (TW-121, due Oct 30).
Expo invites go out today to the 40-lead list. Lead list ticket TW-122 is due Oct 28.
Maya is sending the October investor update today (TW-111, due today).
Arjun's second backend interview is at 3pm today (TW-110).
Earlier decision stands: Smart Slots is the priority until the Nov 4 Expo, and sync errors wait unless they worsen.
